items.title: Musk Says SpaceX Could Buy a Legacy Telco and Use Its Spectrum 10 Times Better
items.summary: Musk hinted at a telecom takeover without naming a target, while a rival CEO put a staggering price on SpaceX's ambitions. Debt, regulators, and a spectrum gap stand between the boast and a real deal.

items.title: Nasdaq Rout Gives Way to Unusual Options Activity and Bullish Bets on Nvidia, AT&T and Alphabet Stocks
items.summary: After Thursday’s Nasdaq 100 rout, stocks rebound on strong jobs data. Institutional traders placed bullish bets: a weekly Nvidia call spread, an AT&T bull put spread, and a 7,500-contract Alphabet January bull call spread offering a roughly 9-to-1 maximum payoff.

items.title: AST SpaceMobile Fell 26% in a Week. The November 9 Report Has to Answer the Dilution Question
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAST SpaceMobile is down 26% in the past week, a slide that began with reports that SpaceX is in talks to buy Boost Mobile, ahead of AST’s third-quarter report on Monday, Nov. 9.
